title: Capsules
description: Physically extract structures from the world, save them to a global cloud, and deploy them anywhere. Share your custom blueprints with friends!
body:
Ever spent hours building the perfect base, only to realize you need to relocate thousands of blocks away? Tearing down your house block by block is a thing of the past. The Capsules Mod introduces a completely new way to manage, extract, and deploy structures using physical capsules and cloud storage.

Pack up your entire base, store it in your personal cloud, and rebuild it anywhere instantly!
✨ Core Features

    Physical Extraction: The Capsule Scanner doesn't just copy buildings; it physically removes the blocks from the world, leaving a clean slate behind.

    Global Cloud Storage: Every blueprint you scan is safely uploaded to a global cloud database attached to your player profile. Access your structures from anywhere, even in other dimensions.

    Advanced Scanning Filters: You have total control. Set a safe scan radius (up to 16 blocks), toggle the "Ignore Floating" option to avoid aerial trash, and type in specific blocks (like dirt or stone) to exclude them from the scan.

    Perfect Preservation: Block entities retain their data. When you deploy a structure, all your chests, furnaces, and machines will have their items and progress perfectly intact.

    Multiplayer Ready: Your cloud database is designed for multiplayer. Share your custom blueprints and designs with your friends on the server.

    Balanced Economy: Generating structures requires FE (Forge Energy). The mod dynamically calculates the energy cost based on the materials used. Simple wood is cheap, but dense storage blocks and rare ores will require a serious power grid.

⚙️ Machines & Items
The Capsule Scanner

Place this block near your structure to begin. Define your radius, name your blueprint, and apply your filters. You can choose to simply Save the blueprint to the cloud, or hit Generate Capsule to instantly extract the building from the world and pop out a physical item.
The Capsule Generator

Powered by standard FE, this machine is your connection to the cloud. Browse through your saved blueprints, check their energy costs, rename them to keep your database organized, and print them into physical items.
The Capsules

The Generator offers two output modes to suit your building needs:

    Standard Capsule: A single-use item. Right-click the ground to deploy your structure instantly. Perfect for relocating your main base from point A to point B.

    Battery Capsule: The ultimate tool for modular building. This rechargeable capsule allows you to deploy the exact same structure multiple times in a row. Perfect for long roads, walls, or repetitive rooms. Once the charges run out, simply put it back into the Generator to recharge it.

Get ready to build smarter, not harder. Download Capsules today!
